'''Johnny Vegas''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2001 Milford tournament]] on 1 September 2001, according to Stephen Cellucci's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2922">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-mad2922/ you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-ma], DeckTech (Stephen "The Gov'na" Cellucci, 3 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-mad2922/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
